familyInclusionTests: Meaning or communicative force is not completely predictable from individual words.
Japanese conventionally prefers the recorded wording.
Register or social choice is materially important.
The item is a reusable communicative or substitution pattern.
The item is a conventional response, discourse organizer, or interactional formula.
exclusions: Register variants counted as separate families
Dialogue lines counted as separate families
Particles and inflection endings represented as Vocabulary links
verifiedLabelRule: The learner-facing Verified expression label is permitted only when every required gate has passed.
countingRule: Only distinct expression families count toward the 3000–5000 production target.
